title: Wall Mount Shower Curtain Brackets And Rod 1-Inch Solid Brass Pair, Prestige Regal Collection | Polished Nickel | Allied Brass
description:
Add a finished look to your bathroom with shower curtain brackets and rod support designed for any 1-inch diameter shower rod in Polished Nickel, which offers a softer, warmer alternative to chrome with a subtle golden undertone that suits transitional spaces. These wall mount shower rod brackets are crafted from solid brass and coordinate with the Prestige Regal Collection for transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Polished Nickel coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Wall-mounted design with concealed screw mounting hardware
- Multiple designer finish options available for coordinating with other bathroom accessories
- Shower rod sold separately; installation hardware included

Specs & Details:
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Fits: Any 1-inch diameter shower rod
- Dimensions (each): 3 in L x 3 in W x 2.25 in H; 2 in projection
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Product weight: 1.6 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
